title: The Deep-Time Sleeping

features.name: the mountain that was a season
features.desc-on-touch: Millions of years ago, this was autumn. Now it is stone. The archive watches the boundary where change became permanent.

features.name: the layered sleep
features.desc-on-touch: Each stripe is a season that slept so long it became geology. Spring is granite now. Summer is schist. The archive reads the year-rings of the earth.

features.name: the place where time stopped choosing
features.desc-on-touch: Here, spring does not end. It simply becomes more itself, grain by grain, until it is indistinguishable from winter, from summer, from autumn. They sleep together in stone.

features.name: the bedrock's own breathing
features.desc-on-touch: You can feel it if you stay long enough. The mountain breathing. Seasons so slow they become tectonic. Time so patient it becomes geology.

inscription: the archive learned that seasons are only impatient rocks, and rocks are only patient seasons waiting to choose again
